comment: binhash.go.src and cascade_test.go.src are byte-for-byte copies of two files of the Melusina monorepo's sidecar boot
gate (shared/melusina-attest/binhash). They are test data, never compiled: the .src suffix keeps every Go tool off them.
root_store_boot_cascade_test.go reads the Refusal* constants from binhash.go and the refusal table (case name and
expected reason) from cascade_test.go, and requires the Store's own cascade, run for the root Store at boot, to refuse
each of those cases by the same name. Do not edit the copies. sourceCommit must be the commit vendor/ was exported
from (testdata/melusina-vendor/vendor.provenance.json), so the refusal names and the decoders the Store compiles come
from one Melusina commit. To move both, re-vendor first, then copy the two files from that commit, update every field
below, and replace git-objects/ with that commit's objects:
The test checks, without a Melusina clone, that each copy's size, sha256 and git blob id are the ones recorded here,
and walks from the recorded commit through those trees to each recorded blob; every object in git-objects/ must be on
